title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
U.S. Department of Justice
       Office of the Solicitor General




       Washington, D.C. 20530

       July 2, 2025

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

  Re:  Department of Education v. Career Colleges and Schools of Texas,
No. 24-413

Dear Mr. Harris:

 The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on January 10,
2025.  A motion to hold the briefing schedule in abeyance was granted on February 6, 2025, and
a motion to resume merits briefing was granted on June 23, 2025.

Because of the press of other cases, the parties respectfully request, under this Court’s Rule
30.4, that the time within which to file petitioner s’ brief (and the joint appendix) be extended to
and including August 20, 2025, and that the time within which to file respondents’ brief be
extended to and including October 2, 2025.  If those extensions are granted, petitioners’ reply brief
would be due on October 31, 2025.

 Respondent’s counsel has authorized us to state that respondent consents to this briefing
schedule.


      Sincerely,



      D. John Sauer
      Solicitor General
